faq.title: Questions before you start with PloroAI
faq.description: Straight answers about plans, AI review, cancellation, payments, invoices, and beta limits before you create an account.

whatIs.question: What is PloroAI?
whatIs.answer: PloroAI helps electricians and electrical contractors prepare quotes from floor plans and project documentation with AI assistance.

aiReview.question: Do AI results need to be reviewed?
aiReview.answer: Yes. AI suggestions are editable and must be reviewed by the user before sending a quote, ordering materials, or relying on quantities.

free.question: What can I do on the Free plan?
free.answer: Free allows 1 floor plan and 1 quote, intended for trying the app.

basic.question: What is included in Basic?
basic.answer: Basic includes up to 10 floor plans and 10 quotes per billing period, AI floor plan analysis, and PDF/Excel export.

pro.question: What is included in Pro?
pro.answer: Pro includes up to 20 floor plans, 20 quotes, and 3 project documentation PDF analyses during beta, plus candidate review/import into quotes.

cancel.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
cancel.answer: Yes. Paid subscriptions are managed through Stripe Customer Portal and can be canceled there. Access normally remains available until the end of the current paid period when cancellation is scheduled at period end.

payments.question: How are payments handled?
payments.answer: Payments are card-only and processed securely through Stripe. PloroAI does not store card data.

invoices.question: How are invoices handled?
invoices.answer: Stripe payment confirmation is separate from local/legal invoice issuance. Invoices are processed manually according to billing profile and customer type, using the operator's accounting/Synesis workflow where applicable.

refund.question: Can I get a refund or do I have 14 days to withdraw?
refund.answer: For consumers, the right to withdraw from a distance contract within 14 days may apply under EU/Croatian consumer rules, subject to legal exceptions for digital services/content and depending on whether the service has already started or been used. Refund or withdrawal requests should be sent to contact@ploroai.io with account email, invoice number if issued, Stripe transaction/payment/invoice ID if available, and a short explanation. Final refund wording must be reviewed by lawyer/accountant before production.

storage.question: Where are project files stored?
storage.answer: Project data and uploaded files are intended to be stored using EU-hosted infrastructure where configured by the operator. Final hosting and storage regions should be verified before production launch.

projectPdf.question: Can I analyze large PDF project documentation?
projectPdf.answer: Yes, on Pro. Project PDF analysis is currently a beta feature. AI extracts material/labor candidates, and the user reviews them before accepted material candidates can be imported into a quote.

contact.question: Who can I contact?
contact.answer: Contact contact@ploroai.io for product, billing, refund/withdrawal, or project documentation questions. The Contact and Complaints pages include the public support path.

legalBases.body: The intended legal bases may include contract performance, legal obligations, legitimate interests, and consent where applicable. Final legal-basis wording must be reviewed before production launch.
items: Contract performance for account access, SaaS functionality, subscriptions, and support
Legal obligations for billing, accounting, tax, and invoicing records
Legitimate interest for security, abuse prevention, service improvement, and beta support
Consent where optional cookies, future analytics, or similar optional processing are introduced

processors.title: Processors and subprocessors
processors.body: The service may use third-party processors for infrastructure, payments, AI analysis, and email. The final processor list and data-processing agreements must be verified before production launch.
items: Hosting, database, and storage provider, including Supabase or equivalent configured infrastructure
Stripe for card payments, checkout, subscriptions, and customer portal
OpenAI or another AI service provider for analysis of uploaded plans and project documents
SMTP/email provider for password reset and service emails
Analytics are not currently described as active; if added later, this policy must be updated

storage.title: Storage and infrastructure region
storage.body: Project data is intended to be stored in EU-hosted infrastructure where configured by the operator. Final hosting, database, and storage regions must be verified before production launch.
items: Uploaded project files and generated data are stored using configured cloud infrastructure
Do not rely on this page as a final EU-only storage guarantee until deployment configuration is verified
AI and payment providers may process data under their own infrastructure and safeguards

retention.title: Data retention
retention.body: Retention periods are beta placeholders and must be finalized. Data is generally kept only as long as needed for the service, legal/accounting duties, security, backups, and support.
items: Account data while the account exists or as needed for legitimate support/security needs
Billing and invoice records according to applicable legal/accounting retention rules
Project data until deleted by the user or account closure, subject to backups and legal obligations
Rate-limit, security, and operational logs for a limited operational period
TODO: final retention periods must be defined before production launch

rights.title: GDPR rights
rights.body: Subject to legal conditions, users may exercise GDPR rights by contacting contact@ploroai.io. Users also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Croatian data protection authority, AZOP.
items: Access to personal data
Correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
Deletion where applicable
Restriction of processing
Objection to processing where applicable
Data portability where applicable
Withdrawal of consent where processing is based on consent
Complaint to AZOP, the Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.body: Some providers, including AI or payment providers, may process data outside the EU/EEA under appropriate safeguards where applicable. This must be verified in final processor documentation.
items: Do not treat this beta notice as a guarantee that every processing activity is EU-only
Provider safeguards and transfer mechanisms must be reviewed before production launch

privacyContact.title: Privacy contact
privacyContact.body: For privacy requests, account-data questions, project deletion requests, or processor questions, contact PloroAI at contact@ploroai.io.
items: Include the account email related to the request
Do not send passwords or sensitive access tokens by email

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.description: Beta-release terms for using PloroAI, an AI-assisted SaaS application for preparing electrical quotes from floor plans and project documentation.

metadata.title: Terms of Service - PloroAI
metadata.description: Terms for PloroAI beta use, AI review responsibility, subscriptions, usage limits, uploaded content, and Croatian-law placeholders.

provider.title: Service provider
provider.body: PloroAI is operated by Živić Elektro j.d.o.o., OIB/VAT ID HR90344764519, 204. vukovarske brigade 39, 32000 Vukovar, Hrvatska. Contact: contact@ploroai.io.
items: Product name: PloroAI
Service type: SaaS application for AI-assisted electrical quote preparation

service.title: Description of service
service.body: PloroAI helps users prepare electrical quotes from floor plans and, for Pro beta users, project documentation PDFs. The product supports project setup, AI analysis, room review, material suggestions, quote generation, and PDF/Excel exports.
items: Free and Basic focus on the floor-plan-to-quote workflow
Pro beta includes project documentation PDF analysis and reviewed material candidate import

account.title: Account terms
account.body: Users must provide accurate account and billing information and are responsible for maintaining account security.
items: Keep login credentials confidential
Keep billing profile data accurate for subscription and invoice processing
Notify support if unauthorized account access is suspected

aiDisclaimer.title: AI outputs require user review
aiDisclaimer.body: AI outputs are suggestions and candidates. Users must review all detected rooms, material candidates, labor candidates, prices, assumptions, and quote content before sending quotes or ordering materials.
items: PloroAI does not replace certified engineering or project documentation
AI output is not guaranteed to be complete, correct, code-compliant, or suitable for installation without professional review
Final responsibility for quotes, material quantities, labor assumptions, and client communication remains with the user

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions, payments, and invoices
subscriptions.body: Payments are accepted only by card through Stripe. Subscriptions are monthly and can be managed or cancelled through Stripe Customer Portal. Prices and plan descriptions are shown on the Pricing page.
items: Access may continue until the current paid period ends depending on Stripe subscription status
Stripe payment confirmation is not the same as Croatian legal invoice issuance
Invoices/local fiscal documents are handled separately and manually based on billing profile and customer type
Where applicable, local invoicing is issued or processed through the operator's accounting workflow/Synesis
The app does not promise automatic fiscalization or e-invoice generation

usageLimits.title: Usage limits
usageLimits.body: The beta plan limits currently implemented in the application are listed below. Limits may change with notice for future plans or after beta.
items: Free: 1 floor plan, 1 quote, 0 project PDF analyses
Basic: 10 floor plans, 10 quotes, 0 project PDF analyses
Pro beta: 20 floor plans, 20 quotes, 3 project PDF analyses

uploadedContent.title: Uploaded content
uploadedContent.body: Users must have the right to upload floor plans, project documentation, client data, and related files. Users should not upload unlawful content or sensitive third-party data unless authorized.
items: Uploaded content may be stored and processed to provide the service
Uploaded files may be processed by AI service providers for analysis
The user remains responsible for checking rights and permissions for uploaded documents

proBeta.title: Pro documentation beta
proBeta.body: Project documentation PDF analysis is a beta feature. Extracted material and labor candidates require review, acceptance, rejection, and editing by the user.
items: Accepted material candidates can be imported into the quote workflow
Labor candidates are reviewed but not imported into quote totals yet
Extraction quality may vary by document quality, structure, and language

termination.title: Cancellation and termination
termination.body: Users can cancel paid subscriptions through Stripe Customer Portal. The operator may restrict or terminate access in cases of misuse, security risk, non-payment, or unlawful activity.
items: Cancellation does not automatically remove legal/accounting records
Project data deletion may be subject to backups, accounting obligations, or legal duties

misuse.title: Prohibited misuse
misuse.body: Do not upload unlawful content, attempt to access another user's data, abuse rate limits, reverse engineer protected services, disrupt the app, or use PloroAI to produce misleading quotes.
items: No unauthorized access, scraping, credential sharing, or security testing without permission
No use of the service to infringe third-party rights or legal obligations

disclaimer.title: Limitation and disclaimer placeholder
disclaimer.body: The service is provided as beta software and may contain errors or availability interruptions. Final warranty, liability, limitation, refund, consumer, and business-customer wording must be reviewed by legal counsel before production launch.
items: This section intentionally remains conservative and unfinished until legal review

governingLaw.title: Governing law placeholder
governingLaw.body: These beta terms are intended to be governed by the laws of the Republic of Croatia, subject to mandatory consumer protection rules where applicable. This wording requires final legal review.

metadata.title: Written complaints - PloroAI

emailProcess.title: How to submit a complaint
emailProcess.body: Submit written complaints by email to contact@ploroai.io. No contact form is provided on this page.
items: Use the subject line: Written complaint - PloroAI
Send the complaint from the billing email or account email where possible

requiredInfo.title: Information to include
requiredInfo.body: Include enough information for the operator to identify the customer, account, payment, subscription, and issue.
items: Buyer/customer name or company name
Billing email
Account email if different
Invoice number if issued
Stripe transaction, payment, or invoice ID if available
Subscription plan
Date of transaction or payment
Short description of the complaint
Relevant screenshots or documents

deadline.title: Response deadline
deadline.body: Written complaints will be answered in writing within 15 days of receipt, in line with Croatian consumer-protection information on written complaints.
items: Responses are sent to the email address used for the complaint or billing profile

pendingInvoice.title: If an invoice is pending
pendingInvoice.body: If a local invoice has not yet been issued manually or a Synesis/accounting task is pending, include Stripe transaction details and billing profile data anyway.
items: Stripe payment confirmation is not the same as local Croatian legal invoice issuance
Manual invoice review depends on customer type and billing profile data
